auth_sign_in_subtitle: Pezani malo anu ogwira ntchito kuchipatala motetezeka.
auth_welcome_back_body: Lowani muakaunti yanu kuti muyang'anire odwala, katundu, nthawi yokumana, ndi kayendetsedwe ka ntchito zachipatala za gulu lanu.
auth_welcome_signup_body: Pangani akaunti kuti muyang'anire odwala, katundu, nthawi yoikidwiratu, ndi mayendedwe achipatala a gulu lanu.
auth_forgot_subtitle: Lowetsani imelo ku akaunti yanu. Titumiza ulalo wokhazikitsanso ngati ukugwirizana ndi wolembetsa.
auth_check_email_body: Ngati {email} idalembetsedwa, ulalo wokonzanso uli m'njira. Ulalo utha pakadutsa mphindi 15.
auth_set_password_hint: Malembo osachepera 8 okhala ndi nambala ndi chizindikiro.
auth_otp_subtitle: Tinatumiza nambala 6 ku {email}. Itha ntchito pakadutsa mphindi 10.
auth_otp_resent: Khodi yatsopano yatumizidwa ku imelo yanu.
auth_2fa_subtitle: Lowetsani manambala 6 kuchokera ku pulogalamu yanu yotsimikizira.
auth_2fa_use_backup: Gwiritsani ntchito nambala yosunga zobwezeretsera m'malo mwake
auth_2fa_setup_subtitle: Tsimikizirani mawu achinsinsi anu kuti mupange khodi ya QR yotsimikizira.
auth_2fa_setup_scan_subtitle: Jambulani ndi pulogalamu yanu yotsimikizira, kenako lowetsani manambala 6.
auth_2fa_backup_codes_title: Sungani ma code anu osunga zobwezeretsera
auth_2fa_backup_codes_subtitle: Sungani ma code awa penapake motetezeka. Khodi iliyonse itha kugwiritsidwa ntchito kamodzi.
auth_2fa_account_enabled_hint: Akaunti yanu imatetezedwa ndi pulogalamu yotsimikizira.
auth_2fa_account_disable_hint: Lowetsani mawu achinsinsi anu kuti muzimitse kutsimikizika kwazinthu ziwiri.
auth_2fa_account_change_hint: Sinthani chotsimikizira chanu. Mapulogalamu omwe alipo adzasiya kugwira ntchito mpaka mutayang'ana QR yatsopano.
auth_2fa_setup_change_subtitle: Tsimikizirani mawu achinsinsi anu kuti mulowetse nambala yanu ya QR yotsimikizira.
auth_2fa_account_backup_regen_hint: Lowetsani mawu anu achinsinsi. Makhodi osunga zosunga zobwezeretsera am'mbuyomu asiya kugwira ntchito.
auth_2fa_account_backup_regen_success: Makhodi atsopano osunga zobwezeretsera ndi okonzeka. Apulumutseni kwinakwake kotetezeka.
session_extend_description: Tsimikizirani mawu achinsinsi anu kuti muwonjezere maola ena awiri kugawoli.
session_extend_password_hint: Lowetsani mawu achinsinsi a akaunti yomwe mwalowa nayo. Mutha kuwonjezera kamodzi pa gawo lililonse.
auth_2fa_account_multi_device_hint: Mukakhazikitsa mutha kuyang'ana QR yomweyo ndi zida zopitilira chimodzi.
auth_2fa_required_for_action: Kutsimikizika kwazinthu ziwiri ndikofunikira pakuchita izi. Ikhazikitseni kuti mupitilize.
set_new_password_description: Khazikitsani mawu achinsinsi a akaunti yanu.
enter_email_reset_description: Lowetsani imelo yanu ndipo tikutumizirani ulalo kuti mukonzenso mawu achinsinsi anu.
invalid_reset_link: Ulalo wokhazikitsanso wolakwika kapena watha. Chonde funsani yatsopano pansipa.
password_min_length: Mawu achinsinsi ayenera kukhala osachepera zilembo 8.
reset_email_sent: Ngati pali akaunti ya imelo iyi, ulalo wokhazikitsanso mawu achinsinsi watumizidwa.
password_reset_success: Kukhazikitsanso mawu achinsinsi bwino. Tsopano mutha kulowa.
op_billing_select_visit_hint: Sankhani ulendo kuti muyambitse kulipira kwa OP.
op_billing_discount_locked_after_print: Bilu iyi idasindikizidwa; kuchotsera kwapaulendo sikungasinthidwe.
op_billing_nothing_to_close: Palibe ntchito zomwe zamalizidwa zomwe zikudikirira kulipira paulendowu.
op_billing_no_services_found: Palibe ntchito zomwe zamalizidwa zomwe zikudikirira kulipira paulendowu.
op_billing_readiness_nursing_hint: Malizitsani unamwino wathunthu pamizere yonse yothandizira musanatseke.
op_billing_bill_close_blocked_no_lines: Palibe mizere yolipiritsa pa bilu iyi.

no_hospital_assigned: Palibe chipatala choperekedwa ku akaunti yanu. Lumikizanani ndi woyang'anira wanu.
no_hospitals_yet: Palibe zipatala pano. Pangani imodzi kuti muyambe.
owner_no_hospitals_yet: Palibe zipatala pano. Lumikizanani ndi woyang'anira wanu kuti muyambe.
hospital_coding_system_help: Amamanga chipatalachi ku muyezo umodzi wa WHO. Sizingasinthidwe pambuyo poti matenda apezeka.
hospital_coding_system_locked: Dongosolo lokhotakhota ndi lokhoma chifukwa chipatalachi chili ndi zizindikiro za matenda.
hospital_coding_release_unknown: Palibe kulowetsedwa kwa catalog ya WHO komwe kudalembedwa pano.
icd_who_attribution: Zomwe zili mu ICD-10 ndi ICD-11 ndizovomerezeka ndi World Health Organisation (WHO). ICD-11 ili ndi chilolezo pansi pa CC BY-ND 3.0 IGO. Kugwiritsa ntchito kumafuna chidziwitso; Zosintha zimafunikira chilolezo cha WHO.
docs_coding_standards_body: Chipatala chilichonse chimamanga dongosolo limodzi la WHO la kuzindikira (ICD-10 kapena ICD-11 MMS) panthawi yopanga. Kusaka kwa EMR kumagwiritsa ntchito kalozera kokha. Makasitomala athunthu amatumizidwa kudzera pa WHO ICD-API pagome logawana nawo.
name: Dzina
admin_overview_subtitle: Kuwerengera ndi njira zazifupi zoyendetsera dongosolo.
admin_no_hospitals_yet: Palibe zipatala pano. Pangani imodzi ndikumanga eni ake.
admin_team_subtitle: Itanani othandizira ndikukhazikitsa masamba omwe angagwiritse ntchito.
admin_team_invite_title: Itanani membala wa gulu la admin
admin_team_edit_title: Sinthani membala wa gulu la admin
admin_team_empty: Palibe mamembala a gulu la admin panobe.
admin_team_need_view: Tsamba limodzi liyenera kukhala ndi chilolezo chowonera.
admin_team_invite_hint: Adzalandira imelo yobwezeretsanso mawu achinsinsi kuti akhazikitse mawu achinsinsi awo.
admin_team_matrix_hint: Kuwona ndikofunikira musanapange, kusintha, kapena kufufuta patsamba.
admin_team_reset_failed: Sizinathe kutumiza imelo yokhazikitsanso mawu achinsinsi.
admin_team_revoked: Chilolezo cha membala wa gulu chathetsedwa.
admin_monitoring_subtitle: Kugwiritsa ntchito, zochitika zaposachedwa, ndi thanzi la database.
admin_staff_subtitle: Ogwiritsa ntchito onse omwe ali ndi udindo wogwira ntchito m'zipatala zonse.
admin_ops_subtitle: Kugwiritsa ntchito pompopompo, zochitika zaposachedwa, komanso thanzi la database.
admin_ops_load_error: Sitinathe kutsitsa zomwe zikuchitika komanso zokhudzana ndi thanzi.
admin_ops_usage_subtitle: Magawo ndi zomwe zapangidwa posachedwa kuchokera pankhokwe yamoyo.
admin_ops_activity_subtitle: Ma logins aposachedwa ndi kupanga bungwe.
admin_ops_db_subtitle: Momwe mungalumikizire ndi kusungirako kuchokera ku PostgreSQL.
admin_ops_db_quota_note: Kukonzekera kwadongosolo sikuwululidwa kudzera pa SQL. Onani Neon console kuti isungidwe.
admin_ops_db_note_size_from_pg: Kukula kwa database kumachokera ku PostgreSQL pg_database_size (kukula koyenera pa nthambi ya Neon iyi).
admin_ops_db_note_quota_via_neon: Neon plan yosungirako quota palibe kudzera pa SQL. Kugwiritsidwa ntchito motsutsana ndi kupezeka kumafuna Neon console kapena Neon API.
admin_ops_db_note_live_counts: Ziwerengero zamizere zimakhala COUNT(*) pamizere yayikulu, osati kuyerekezera kwa pg_stat.
admin_ops_db_note_connection_failed: Kufufuza kwalumikizidwe kwalephera. Onani DATABASE_URL ndi Neon nthambi.
no_owners_yet: Palibe eni ake pano. Pangani imodzi yowalola kupeza zipatala.
no_user_groups_yet: Palibe magulu ogwiritsa ntchito panobe. Pangani imodzi kuti mugawire antchito.
no_user_groups_create: Palibe magulu ogwiritsa ntchito. Pangani imodzi pamwamba.
no_branches_yet: Palibe nthambi panobe. Onjezani nthambi yachipatalachi.
user_groups_optional_hint: Sankhani gulu limodzi kapena angapo ogwiritsa ntchito (ngati mukufuna).
store_central_help: Pafupifupi imodzi pa nthambi iliyonse. GRN imayika katundu mu sitolo iyi. Ngati muli kale ndi sitolo yapakati panthambi iyi, zimitsani pamenepo musanayitse pano.
item_master_barcode_scan_hint: Ma scanner a USB nthawi zambiri amalemba m'gawo lolunjika. Kusanthula kwa kamera kutha kuwonjezedwa pambuyo pake.
item_master_batch_required_help: Ikayatsidwa, chiphaso cha katundu chikuyenera kukhala ndi nambala ya batch, tsiku lotha ntchito, ndi mtengo wogulira chinthuchi (chomwe chimakhala pa pharmacy).
item_master_unit_conversions_default_toa: Sankhani chinthu choyamba, kenako gwiritsani ntchito Default kuti mufanane ndi zosintha zomwe zikuphatikiza.
Palibe zosintha zamayunitsi zomwe zimagwiritsidwa ntchito pogula kapena kutulutsa.
item_master_unit_conversions_search_plac: Sefa ndi mawu otembenuza kapena id...
item_master_unit_conversions_default_req: Sankhani chosasintha pakati pa mayunitsi osinthidwa.
item_master_unit_conversions_no_filter_m: Palibe zosintha zomwe zikufanana ndi fyulutayi.
item_master_category_hint: Zowonjezera Zonse, Zogulitsa Pharmacy, kapena Zachipatala (kuchokera ku Category Master).
item_master_pharmacy_generic_required: Sankhani mtundu wamba wa zinthu za Pharmacy Supply.
no_pharmacy_generics_create: Palibe mankhwala ogulitsa mankhwala. Pangani imodzi pamwamba.
unit_master_empty: Palibe mayunitsi panobe. Pangani imodzi pamwamba.
no_item_unit_profiles: Palibe zotembenuka pano. Pangani imodzi pamwamba.
confirm_delete_refer: Kodi mukutsimikiza kuti mukufuna kuchotsa zolozerazi?
support_unauthorized: Muyenera kulowa kuti mugwiritse ntchito chithandizo.
nursing_case_sheet_save_success: Tsamba lamilandu lasungidwa kuzinthu za odwala.
nursing_case_sheet_save_failed: Zalephera kusunga pepala lamilandu ku zomata za odwala.
clinical_document_save_failed: Zalephera kusunga mafomu ku zomata za odwala.
nursing_case_sheet_choose_visit: Sankhani ulendo pogwiritsa ntchito batani la 'Sankhani Kuchezera' pamwamba kuti muwone pepalalo.
observation_emr_choose_visit: Sankhani malo ochezera pogwiritsa ntchito batani la 'Sankhani Kuchezera' pamwambapa kuti muwone zowonera.
clinical_visit_signed_banner: Ulendowu udasungidwa ngati wasainidwa. Kuwonera ndi kusintha kwa CPOE kuzimitsidwa mpaka mutasankha ulendo wina.
clinical_visit_unsign_confirm: Kodi mukutsimikiza kuti sinthani kusunga momwe mwasaina?
observation_save_as_signed_confirm: Sungani ulendowu ngati wasainidwa? Izi sizingasinthidwe. Kuyang'anitsitsa ndi kusintha kwa CPOE kudzazimitsidwa paulendowu; unamwino workbench amakhalapo.
observation_emr_casesheet_stub: Plan of Care palibe mumangidwe awa. Gwiritsani ntchito ndondomeko ya unamwino ya EMR ya chisamaliro ikakonzeka.
observation_emr_plan_of_care_not_found: Dongosolo limenelo la mbiri ya chisamaliro silinapezeke.
observation_emr_progress_note_stub: Zolemba za momwe zikuyendera sizipezeka mumapangidwe awa. Gwiritsani ntchito zolemba za unamwino za EMR zikakonzeka.
consultation_cpoe_prescription_note_plac: Lembani malangizo, mankhwala, mlingo, ndi malangizo kwa wodwalayo...
consultation_cpoe_prescription_delete_hi: Cholemba ichi chizindidwa ngati chosagwira ntchito.
observation_emr_order_line_locked_op_bil: Mzerewu uli pa bilu yotsekedwa ya OP ndipo sungathe kusinthidwa kapena kuyimitsidwa.
observation_emr_order_line_inactivate_hi: Mzere woyitanitsawu udziwika kuti sakugwira ntchito ndikuchotsedwa pamalipiro a OP.
observation_emr_form_entry_inactivate_hi: Lembaninso zomwe zalembedwa m'munsimu kuti musatsegule.
delete_owner_confirm_suffix: ? Izi zichotsa akaunti yawo ndipo sangathenso kulowa.
service_item_select_category_sub_categor: Chonde sankhani gulu ndi kagawo kakang'ono.
prefix_configuration_format_help: Zidutswa zimaphatikizidwa kuti apange code iliyonse. Onjezani zolemba zokhazikika, magawo a data, ndi nambala yomwe ikuyenda.
prefix_configuration_field_visit_order_k: Pitani ku nambala kapena pitani chizindikiritso
prefix_configuration_format_load_failed: Mtundu wosungidwa sunathe kukwezedwa; kuyambira pamakonzedwe okhazikika.
prefix_configuration_page_subtitle: Khazikitsani momwe ma code odwala, manambala oyendera, ndi manambala oyitanitsa chithandizo amamangidwira. Cholinga chilichonse chimagwiritsa ntchito kiyi yokhazikika; mumangosintha kufotokozera ndi mawonekedwe.
prefix_configuration_purpose_patient_hel: Amagwiritsidwa ntchito polembetsa odwala atsopano. Mtundu wochezera palibe pakhodi iyi.
prefix_configuration_purpose_visit_help: Amagwiritsidwa ntchito paulendo uliwonse wodwala; imaphatikizapo mtundu wa nthambi ndi maulendo pamene magawowo ali mumpangidwe.
prefix_configuration_purpose_order_help: Amagwiritsidwa ntchito popanga madongosolo a ntchito. Mawonekedwe ofikira akufanana ndi YY/visit/NNN. Yatsani "Kuyenderana kosiyana paulendo uliwonse" kuti manambala ayitanitsa aziwerengera 001, 002… paulendo wa odwala (omwe akulimbikitsidwa). Ngati ili yozimitsa, ndondomekoyi imagawidwa pamaoda onse omwe amagwiritsa ntchito makonda ena ofanana.
prefix_configuration_purpose_pr_help: Amagwiritsidwa ntchito popanga zofunikira zogulira (PR). Konzani izi antchito asanapange ma PR.
prefix_configuration_purpose_po_help: Amagwiritsidwa ntchito popanga maoda ogula (PO). Konzani izi antchito asanapange ma PO.
prefix_configuration_purpose_di_help: Amagwiritsidwa ntchito popanga ma indents a dipatimenti. Konzani izi antchito asanapange ma indents.
prefix_configuration_purpose_di_issue_he: Amagwiritsidwa ntchito popanga nkhani zamadipatimenti kuyambira pakati mpaka kupempha masitolo.
prefix_configuration_purpose_dc_help: Amagwiritsidwa ntchito popereka zikalata zogwiritsira ntchito dipatimenti kuti zivomerezedwe.
prefix_configuration_purpose_med_order_b: Amagwiritsidwa ntchito posunga malamulo amkati amankhwala. Mizere yonse mu save imodzi igawana nambala iyi. Zosasintha zimagwiritsa ntchito chaka chandalama, chipatala, ndi kutsata ndondomeko.
prefix_configuration_edit_med_order_batc: Mtundu wa nambala ya batchi yamankhwala
prefix_configuration_counter_scope_help: Sankhani miyeso yomwe igawanitse nambala yothamanga. Mtundu wowonetsera pamwambapa ndi wosiyana; izi zimangokhudza kuchuluka kwa magawo odziyimira pawokha omwe mumapeza.
inv_grn_api_hint: Pangani ma GRN kudzera pa POST yokhala ndi poId, storeId (chapakati), receiveDate, ndi mizere. Mzere uliwonse: poLineId, inagulidwaQty (kupatulapo yaulere), batchNo, expiryDate, buyPrice (yofunikira ngati chinthucho chikulondoleredwa). Magulu amasinthidwa (item_batch); katundu ndi pa sitolo ndi batch (inv_stock).
inv_approval_config_intro: Konzani milingo yovomerezeka ndi opatsidwa a sitolo ndi mtundu wa zikalata zomwe mwasankha pamwambapa.
inv_stock_search_modal_hint: Zotsatira zakusaka zikuphatikiza pamanja pa sitolo yosankhidwa (kuchokera) kokha (gawo lotulutsa likapezeka).
inv_receipt_from_store_view_issue_hint: View amatsegula chiphaso ichi patsamba lake; Kubwereranso apa (osati ku nkhani ya Dipatimenti).
inv_stock_lot_hint: Mizere ndi `inv_stock` yolumikizidwa ku `item_batch`, motsatiridwa ndi expiry (FEFO).
inv_user_groups_search_placeholder: Zosefera magulu a ogwiritsa ntchito ndi dzina kapena ID...
inv_user_groups_no_filter_match: Palibe magulu ogwiritsa ntchito omwe akufanana ndi fyulutayi.
inv_pr_approve_qty_hint: Lowetsani kuchuluka kovomerezeka pamzere uliwonse ngati kuyenera kukhala kosiyana ndi kofunsidwa. PR ikudikira kuchuluka kwa magawo makumi anayi ofananira kuchokera ku sitolo yofunsirayi (ikudikirira, kubwezeredwa, kapena kuvomerezedwa), kuphatikiza zomwe mukufuna.
cpoe_order_pending_empty: Palibe zinthu pano. Dinani + kuti muwonjezere chinthu, kenako Sungani dongosolo.
inv_po_new_lines_need_pr_hint: Sankhani zovomerezeka zogulira pamwambapa. Gome lidzadzaza apa ndi mzere uliwonse: chinthu, unit (Item Unit Master conversion), kuchuluka kotsalira, kuchuluka kwa dongosolo, ndi mtengo wagawo.
inv_po_manual_unit_prereq: Sankhani chinthu choyamba, kenako sankhani unit (kutembenuka) kuchokera pamndandanda wa Item Unit Master.
inv_po_manual_unit_none_configured: Chidachi chilibe zosintha zomwe zikuchitika. Konzani iwo pansi pa Kukhazikitsa kwa Inventory → Item master.
inv_po_new_po_pr_cps_only: Sankhani sitolo yogulira chapakati mu kapamwamba. Zofunsira zovomerezeka za oda yatsopano yogulira zimangolembedwa pomwe sitoloyo yasankhidwa: zimatumizidwa ku malo ogulitsira, osati kumasitolo ena monga sitolo yamankhwala yomwe si CPS yokhazikitsidwa.
inv_po_cps_not_configured_pr: Konzani sitolo yapakati yogulira pansi pa Kukhazikitsa kwa Inventory → Kukonzekera kwazinthu zachipatala musanapange maoda ogula kuchokera pazofunikira.
inv_po_close_line_confirm: Tsekani mzere wa PO uwu ndikuyika qty yotsala ngati yotseka?
inv_pr_close_line_confirm: Tsekani mzere wa PR womwe watsala wokwana makumi anayi (kukhazikitsani kutsegulira PO mpaka 0)?
inv_grn_receiving_store_none_central: Palibe sitolo yapakati yomwe idakonzedwera nthambi ya oda iyi. Chiphaso cha katundu chiyenera kutumizidwa ku sitolo yaikulu ya nthambi. Pokhazikitsa Inventory, lembani ndendende sitolo imodzi pa nthambi iliyonse ngati yapakati (ndi sitolo yapakati), ndiye yesaninso.
inv_grn_select_po_for_store_hint: Sankhani oda yogulira kuti muwone sitolo yolandila.
inv_grn_batch_fields_hint: Nambala ya batch, kutha ntchito, ndi mtengo wogulira ndizofunikira pazinthu zotsatiridwa.
inv_transfer_pick_batch_hint: Sankhani zambiri kuchokera kumalo ogulitsira, kapena tsegulani zambiri mutasankha masitolo.
inv_hub_subtitle: Kugula, katundu, ndi kayendedwe ka chipatalachi.
inv_hub_card_po: Pangani ndi kuvomereza maoda ogula, tumizani kwa ogulitsa.
inv_hub_card_grn: Lembani risiti ya katundu motsutsana ndi maoda ogula.
inv_hub_card_stock: Onani katundu ndi sitolo ndi magulu.
inv_hub_card_transfer: Sungani katundu pakati pa masitolo (ndi gulu).
inv_store_central_purchasing_readonly: Kugula kwapakati kumaperekedwa pansi pa Hospital Inventory config.
inv_setup_central_purchasing_hint: PR, PO, ndi GRN pazinthu zogulidwa zimagwiritsa ntchito sitoloyi. Sitolo yosankhidwa imalembedwa ngati Central kugula; yapitayo imabwerera ku Regular.
inv_pr_trace_hint: Pamene mzere uli pa maoda ogula, kuchuluka kotseguka ndi 0 apa; nyimbo zoyitanidwa, zolandilidwa, komanso zolandilidwabe pazithunzi za PO ndi GRN.
inv_pr_trace_po_mismatch: Maoda ogulira alipo pa PR iyi koma mndandandawo sunathe kuikidwa. Yesani kutsitsimutsanso tsamba.
inv_pr_list_scope_hint: Malo apamwamba amayika zosungira zanu / zopempha (ku) sitolo. Mndandandawu ukuwonetsa zofunsira zomwe zidakwezedwa ndi sitoloyo. Sankhani Malo Onse Ogulitsa kuti muwone zofunikira kuchokera kusitolo iliyonse yomwe mukufuna, kapena gwiritsani ntchito fyuluta ya sitolo kuti muchepetse ndi Kuchokera ku sitolo.
inv_stock_list_scope_hint: Zogulitsa zimangokhala m'sitolo mu bar yapamwamba. Sankhani Masitolo Onse kuti muwone sitolo iliyonse m'chipatala.
inv_di_list_scope_hint: Mndandandawu umangokhala ma indents omwe amakwezedwa ndi sitolo mu bar yapamwamba. Sankhani Masitolo Onse kuti muwone ma indents onse a dipatimenti.
inv_flow_procurement_chain: Pangani zofunikira zogula kuchokera ku sitolo yopempha (pamwamba pa bar) → mutavomereza, pangani dongosolo logula ndikuyika GRN mu sitolo yolandirira → pa mndandanda wa GRN, gwiritsani ntchito Transfer kuti musunthire katundu wolandiridwa ku sitolo yomwe inatsegula zofunikira (pamene PR ikugwirizana ndi PO).
inv_flow_pr_context: Kuchokera ku sitolo kumachokera pamwamba. Sankhani Kuti musunge zomwe mukufuna.
inv_flow_po_context: Ma PO a sitolo yosankhidwa (pamwamba bar) amatsatira zogula zovomerezeka kapena kulowa pamanja; vomerezani kenako tumizani kwa ogulitsa katundu musanalandire.
inv_flow_grn_context: Tumizani malisiti mu sitolo yolandirira (zapamwamba). Pamene PO ikugwirizana ndi zomwe mukufuna, gwiritsani ntchito Transfer kutumiza katundu ku sitolo yopemphayo mutatumiza GRN.
inv_po_list_select_store_hint: Sankhani sitolo mu bar yapamwamba kuti muyang'ane pamndandandawu, kapena gwiritsani ntchito Maoda Onse ogula m'chipatala popanda sitolo yosankhidwa.
inv_page_department_issue_subtitle: Sitolo yapakati (pamwamba bar = Kuchokera ku sitolo) imadzutsa zovuta zopempha masitolo: kaya kuchokera ku dipatimenti yovomerezeka yomwe ikuyembekezera kukwaniritsidwa, kapena pamanja popanda cholembera.
inv_flow_dept_issue_context: Monga maoda ogula: gwiritsani ntchito Chatsopano kuchokera ku indent ya dipatimenti pamene katundu afunsidwa ku sitolo yanu yapakati kudzera pa indent; gwiritsani ntchito Manual ngati palibe cholowera.
inv_inventory_from_store_topbar_hint: Sinthani "Kuchokera ku sitolo" kuwongolera pamwamba (pafupi ndi nthambi / gulu la ogwiritsa ntchito) pamene gawo la Inventory latsegulidwa.

inv_di_pending_central_fulfill_hint: Pangani nkhani ya dipatimenti kuchokera ku Inventory → Nkhani ya dipatimenti → Yatsopano kuchokera ku indent ya dipatimenti (sitolo yapakati iyenera kufanana ndi sitolo ya "ku" pa bar yapamwamba).
inv_dept_issue_select_store_hint: Sankhani sitolo yapakati (yokwaniritsa) mu bar yapamwamba. Mndandandawu ukuwonetsa nkhani komwe sitoloyo ndi yopereka (Kuchokera).
inv_page_receipt_from_store_subtitle: Vomerezani kuti mwalandira pa sitolo yomwe mukufunsira (ku bar). Ma indents operekedwa amawonekera pano mpaka atalandilidwa.
inv_receipt_from_store_select_store_hint: Sankhani sitolo yanu yopempha mu bar yapamwamba kuti mulembe zolemba zomwe zikudikirira risiti ku sitoloyo.
inv_page_department_consumption_subtitle: Jambulani kugwiritsidwa ntchito m'sitolo ndi kuchotsera kwa batch-level. Tumizani kuti muvomereze; kuvomereza komaliza kumagwiritsa ntchito ndikuchepetsa katundu.

home_seo_title: Menzies Medora | Maopaleshoni odekha azachipatala a gulu lililonse losamalira
home_seo_description: Medora ndi EMR ya zipatala zambiri zolembera, kuyendera, ntchito zachipatala, kufufuza, ndi kuyang'anira. One Soft Wash console ya eni, antchito, ndi malo osamalira.
home_hero_headline: Sinthani masiku akuchipatala kukhala oyenda mwabata, olumikizana
home_hero_body: Medora: ntchito zosamalira zipatala zingapo ndikulembetsa, kuyendera, mabenchi ogwirira ntchito zachipatala, komanso kuwerengera mu cholembera chimodzi chalendi.
home_how_lead: Kutuluka kumodzi kwa kuyenda-ins ndi chisamaliro chosungitsa. Zopangidwira nthawi zomwe magulu amasuntha odwala.
home_how_step1_body: Jambulani mbiri yanu, zosagwirizana nazo, komanso mbiri yakale. Ulendo uliwonse wotsatira umagwiritsanso ntchito tchati chomwecho.
home_how_step2_body: Pangani maulendo a OP kapena a IP, phatikizani nthawi yokumana, ndipo sungani nkhani zanthambi momveka bwino.
home_how_step3_body: Zofunikira za unamwino, matenda, kulamula kwamankhwala, ndi zikalata zimayendera nthawi yomweyo.
home_how_step4_body: Nkhani za zinthu, zolipiritsa, ndi masitepe otulutsa zimalumikizidwa ndi mbiri yoyendera.
home_modules_lead: Mapaketi otha amaphimba ma desiki omwe amayenera kukhala olumikizana: ofesi yakutsogolo, pansi pachipatala, masitolo, ndi admin.
home_modules_registration_body: Mbuye woleza mtima, kuyendera chilengedwe, maapointimenti, ndi mayendedwe odziwa nthambi.
home_modules_clinical_body: Ma module a unamwino ndi maupangiri okhala ndi zofunikira, matenda, madongosolo, ndi zolemba za EMR.
home_modules_inventory_body: Masitolo, magulu, PR/PO/GRN, kugwiritsa ntchito m'madipatimenti, ndi zidziwitso za katundu.
home_modules_admin_body: Ogwira ntchito, nthambi, magulu ogwiritsa ntchito, ambuye, zikalata, ndi kukhazikitsa zipatala.
home_model_heading: SaaS imodzi. Zipatala zambiri. Chotsani maudindo.
home_model_lead: Medora ndi chipatala chambiri popanga. Pulatifomu imapanga chipatala. Chipatalachi chimakhala ndi chisamaliro. Odwala safuna ofesi yanu yakumbuyo.
home_model_platform_body: System imayang'anira eni mbeu, zipatala, ndi alonda omwe amagawana nawo aliyense.
home_model_hospital_body: Eni ake ndi oyang'anira amakonza nthambi, masitolo, mwayi wogwira ntchito, ndi masters.
home_model_staff_body: Anamwino, madotolo, ndi magulu ogulitsa amagwira ntchito kuchokera kumagawo odziwa bwino omwe ali pansi.
home_model_patients_body: Ma chart, maulendo, ndi zikalata zimakhala ndi chipatala; ogwira ntchito kuchokera ku console.
home_surfaces_nursing_body: Vitals, ziwengo, zolemba za unamwino, ndi ntchito zapampando popanda kusiya ulendowu.
home_surfaces_consult_body: Kuzindikira, kulamula kwamankhwala, ndi zolemba zachipatala za desiki la dokotala.
home_surfaces_inventory_body: Landirani, tulutsani, sinthani, ndikuwunika masheya okhala ndi chidziwitso cha kutha kwa ntchito.
home_surfaces_admin_body: Ogwira ntchito, nthambi, magulu olowa, mabwana a zolemba, ndi kasinthidwe.
home_integrated_heading: Sungani desiki iliyonse pa nthawi imodzi
home_integrated_lead: Maudindo, mankhwala, zikalata, ndi mayendedwe a masheya amagawana ulendowu kuti pansi pakhale bwino.
home_integrated_f3: Zolemba za odwala ndi zilembo zosindikiza
home_integrated_f4: Nthambi ndi mwayi wamagulu ogwiritsa ntchito
home_integrated_f5: Zidziwitso za stock ndi malipoti otha ntchito
home_cta_body: Lowani muakaunti ya Medora, sankhani chipatala, ndikuyamba kuchokera ku ma module omwe gulu lanu limagwiritsa ntchito kale.
home_footer_tagline: Ntchito zachipatala zolembetsa, chisamaliro chachipatala, kufufuza, ndi kuyang'anira.
home_footer_copyright: © {year} Menzies Medora. Care mapulogalamu ndi Menzies.

pricing_seo_title: Mitengo ya Menzies Medora | Cloud ndi Pamalo
pricing_seo_description: Mitengo ya EMR ya chipatala cha Medora: Mtambo kuchokera ku $99/mo (Starter to Platform). Pamalo amagwiritsa ntchito magawo omwewo pamtengo wa Cloud + $150/mo kuti akhazikitse pazomangamanga zanu. Kulembetsa, chipatala, kufufuza, ndi admin.
pricing_lead: Cloud SaaS kapena On-premise pamaziko anu. Zoyambira Zofanana, Bizinesi, Sikelo, ndi Mapulatifomu. Kukula kwa zipatala ndi ma module, osati kudera nkhawa kwa mita.
pricing_lead_cloud: Cloud imakhala ndi Soft Wash Medora: SaaS yazipatala zambiri, zosintha zoyendetsedwa, komanso zida zogawana patsamba lililonse lomwe mumagwiritsa ntchito.
pricing_lead_onprem: Pamalo ndi zida zomwezo, zoyikidwa ndikukhazikitsidwa pa ma seva anu, database, ndi netiweki. Ndinu eni zomangira. Mndandanda wa mwezi uliwonse ndi Mtambo + ${premium} pa udindo umenewo.

pricing_who_heading: Zojambulidwa ku mtundu wa chisamaliro cha Medora
pricing_who_lead: Platform, chipatala, ogwira ntchito, ndi odwala aliyense amapeza njira yabwino. Sankhani Cloud kapena On-premise, ndiye gawo lomwelo lomwe likufanana ndi zipatala zingati ndi ma module omwe mumayendetsa.
pricing_who_platform_body: Othandizira omwe amabzala zipatala zambiri ndipo amafunikira zolemba zoyera kuphatikiza SSO. Sankhani Platform pa Cloud kapena On-premise.
pricing_who_hospital_body: Eni ndi oyang'anira akukonza nthambi, masitolo, mwayi wogwira ntchito, ndi ambuye. Bizinesi kapena Scale imakwanira magulu ambiri amasamba.
pricing_who_staff_body: Anamwino, madotolo, ndi magulu a sitolo pa ma module odziwa ntchito. Mipando malire kukula ndi dongosolo; odwala samawona ofesi yakumbuyo.
pricing_who_patients_body: Ma chart, maulendo, ndi zikalata zimakhala m'chipatala. Ogwira ntchito amatumizidwa kuchokera ku console kudutsa kulembetsa mpaka pafupi.
pricing_faq_q1: Kodi mitengo paulendo uliwonse kapena pampando wa antchito?
pricing_faq_a1: Miyezo yosindikizidwa ndi gulu lililonse lachipatala lomwe lili ndi zipatala ndi mipando. Cloud ndi On-premise amagawana Starter, Business, Scale, and Platform. Mndandanda wa mwezi uliwonse ndi Cloud + $150. Palibe njira iliyonse yomwe imagwiritsa ntchito mita yoyendera yomwe imakwera pamasiku otanganidwa.
pricing_faq_a2: Maloko olipira pachaka mchaka choloseredwa cha Soft Wash Medora. Chipatala cha Loomline SaaS nthawi zambiri chimachotsera mapulani a pachaka pafupifupi 15 mpaka 20%. Medora imachotsa 20% pamndandanda wamwezi uliwonse mukalipira chaka chilichonse, pa Cloud ndi On-premise (pambuyo pa +$150 On-premise premium).
pricing_faq_q3: Kodi zida ndi ma module azachipatala akuphatikizidwa?
pricing_faq_a3: Yoyambira imaphatikizapo kulembetsa koyambira, maulendo, ndi mabenchi ogwira ntchito azachipatala okhala ndi zoyambira. Bizinesi komanso pamwamba tsegulani mayendedwe athunthu azinthu, madongosolo amankhwala olumikizidwa ndi stock, komanso kusanja kwabwino kwa admin. Funsani pamene mukufuna zowonjezera zowonjezera.
pricing_faq_a4: Gwiritsani ntchito kusintha kwa msika pamwamba pa mapulani. Global ikuwonetsa USD yokha. Myanmar ikuwonetsa MMK pa 1 USD = 5000 MMK (yokhala ndi USD ngati mzere wachiwiri). Nthawi yolipiritsa ndi mtundu wa ntchito ndizosiyana ndi msika.
